text: 截至目前，ETF两市成交额报3978.9亿元，较昨日此时放量150.9亿元，分类型来看，股票型ETF成交额888.41亿元，债券型ETF成交额2326.79亿元，货币型ETF成交额316.02亿元，商品型ETF成交额41.07亿元，QDII型ETF成交额406.6亿元。其中，成交额最高的非货币型ETF分别是港股创新药ETF（513120）、科创50ETF（588000）、中韩半导体ETF（513310），成交额分别为：55.63亿元、53.82亿元、53.00亿元。
text_en: As of now, ETF turnover in the two markets was 397.89 billion yuan, up 15.09 billion yuan from the same time yesterday. By type, equity ETF turnover was 88.841 billion yuan, bond ETF turnover was 232.679 billion yuan, money market ETF turnover was 31.602 billion yuan, commodity ETF turnover was 4.107 billion yuan, and QDII ETF turnover was 40.66 billion yuan. Among them, the non-money-market ETFs with the highest turnover were the Hong Kong Innovative Drug ETF (513120), the STAR 50 ETF (588000), and the China-Korea Semiconductor ETF (513310), with turnover of 5.563 billion yuan, 5.382 billion yuan, and 5.300 billion yuan, respectively.
